name: Editorial sticker
description: Light grey paper, thick-outlined sticker windows, colour-changing sections and a hooded host. Fast tech explainers.
rules: Every window is a sticker: 4 px black outline, hard offset shadow, red/grey/white dots.
The background changes colour per section (paper, dark, red, green, slate): bg per shot.
Mono HUD row on top: '// 03 - what it does' left, a counter or keyword in the accent colour right.
Red scribble circles and underlines point at the proof (star count, price, number).
The host stays bottom-centre and gestures on the key words; headline text is the caption.
typography: Sans headline, red italic serif accent, mono HUD.
audio_direction: upbeat bed, pop per card, stamp on verdicts, ding on the comment box
pitfalls: Same background for the whole video.
